newsitem.title: MEXICO: Commerci off on Kmart Mexican unit buy.
newsitem.headline: Commerci off on Kmart Mexican unit buy.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican retail chain Controladora Comercial Mexicana (Comerci) were sharply down in heavy early trade following news it intended to acquire Kmart Corp's Mexican joint venture, traders said.
Commerci's UBC share units were down 26 centavos to head the market's decliner's list, and accounted for 27 percent of all shares traded in early dealing.
Kmart Corp and its Mexican partner El Puerto de Liverpool announced late on Thursday that they were to sell their interests in Kmart de Mexico to Comerci for $148.5 million in cash.
The news came after the close of trade on Thursday, which saw Commerci shares gain on rumours of a joint venture with a major U.S. partner.
Traders' opinions were divided on the reason the stock was down.

"They bought on the rumour, now they're selling on the news. In-and-out traders are obviously taking advantage of the situation until the market has digested the news," a trader from the Arka brokerage said.
Other traders said it was not clear how Comerci intended to finance the deal, as their treasury position was not large enough to cover the announced sale price of Kmart de Mexico.
"Why's the stock down? Because they've just bought Kmart and haven't got the money, that's why," a floor trader said.
